text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka Sho, which
Kitasan Black's
greatest rival,
Brusquement, will be absent from,
has
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We arrive at the track early to get her
psyched up
for the race, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, according to my Bakushin sources,
the
racers who ran the St. Lite Kinen
aren't forecasted
to do great in the
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
BUT! This data's of no consequence! This
race
distance will be no problem either!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're a Bakushin-musume with nerves
of
tempered steel now, and it'll take
more than that
to shake you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I agree with her. It's just a coincidence
that
Kitasan Black doesn't have any
good runs on
record, and 3,000 meters
shouldn't be an issue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The problem is—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I really wanted to settle the score with
her. I
wanted to end the Triple Crown on
a high note
after defeating her. But...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Brusquement... I still can't believe
you're not
running today...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(It's okay, though! I don't need her to
run my best!
No question about that!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(But... Will I be satisfied when all is said
and
done?)

Hello there! You look quite troubled.
Something
on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...!
Nature, what're you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I heard from Bakushin O that you'd
probably be
over here. What's wrong?
Do you wanna talk
about it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see... I had a feeling that might be the
case. It's
hard not to get hung up over
the absence of your
rival, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It was that way for me, too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? You had the same thing happen
to you?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sure did. For me, it was your superstar
Teio who
had gotten hurt.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I felt lost. The one I'd been dreaming of
defeating
was gone.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She didn't recover in time for the race
either.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What did you do then, Nature?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well... I was quite discombobulated and
kept
wondering how I was supposed to
beat someone
who wasn't there...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But it clicked at some point, and I
realized it was
up to me in the end.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it all depended on how I ran that
day
whether people would even notice
Teio's
absence.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So I decided I wasn't going to let anyone
say
there was a big hole in the lineup.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That was the answer I came up with back
then. I'm
not sure if it'll help you much,
though.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whether people notice someone's
missing from
the race or not is all
dependent on how I run...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see. I understand your point now.
You're exactly
right, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I think I've got my
head on
straight now!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Good. Go give it your all. You can only
compete
in the Kikuka Sho once in your
life, so make sure
you finish it without
any regrets, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, you sure are in charge of an
adorable
racer. I only gave her as much
advice as I thought
would help her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I heard the whole thing. Kitasan Black's
emotional
stability was my biggest
concern, but it looks like
she'll be okay.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
This is a bit of a shock to me, though. I
always
figured Kitasan was more like a
radiant star,
different from how I was in
the past.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's kind of comforting to know that even
Kitasan
has weaknesses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look up at the sky without saying
anything. It's
true that Kitasan Black has
weaknesses...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But she's grown so much. And now, she'll
have a
chance to show everyone just
how far she's come
on the turf.
